instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a couple dancing tango in a minimalist indoor space with a plain light gray wall. The woman in the black dress (R2) is positioned in the foreground with her back to the camera, her hair styled in a bun with a blue flower accessory. She dances with the man in the gray suit (R1), who faces forward and looks down towards her. They are in a classic tango embrace, with his right hand resting on her back and their opposite hands clasped and raised. The scene is captured with soft, natural side lighting that highlights their forms against the simple background, creating a warm and intimate mood.
